title: pocketqube-fsm: configuration-driven, model-checked decision engine for PocketQube deployment and downlink scheduling
description: Code, configurations and evidence for the paper "Configuration-driven mode logic for resource-constrained embedded systems: requirement-based model checking, torn-write persistence and a PocketQube case study". Includes the Python engine and three YAML mission configurations, the POQUITO-based simulation, the policy comparison, generated and hand-written TLA+ specifications, the 1,218-test suite, the Zephyr C port for STM32F401RE and STM32L476RG, the archived Renode replay logs for all three configurations (35,763, 35,761 and 35,761 decisions, no mismatches) and the firmware measurements.
